title: The rename changes only words, not permissions, web addresses or data
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the build under test.
custom_steps:
1. Compare every user's access on release day to the day before.
  2. Open an existing bookmark / saved link to the Part Library page.
  3. Confirm no stored data is renamed - only on-screen text changed.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • No permission is added, removed or re-keyed (every user's access is identical to the day before); the Part Library page address does not change so an existing bookmark still resolves.
  • No stored data is renamed - the change is confined to text a user reads on screen.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
